column1: # Next-release builds of pinned Z9X apps, read by tools/play6/z9x_gate.sh (a gate input: any change here is red until
# the maintainer's OK and a re-record). One row per pinned app whose sources already hold reviewed commits for the next Z9X
# release, so HEAD no longer rebuilds its 1.0.9 pin. The gate is green for such an app only when HEAD builds exactly
# the accepted sha256 AND the pin rebuilds byte for byte from the pin commit, so the released APK stays proven.
# app<TAB>pin commit<TAB>sha256 that HEAD builds<TAB>commits since the pin (reason)
